title: RacketPal Rally Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=racketpal:rally
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by sport
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when RacketPal rally data has stopped arriving for a given sport.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per sport and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep when one part of your RacketPal rally feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
